text_block_list.text:
Our senior-year summer has come to an
end—one
I spent running around with
Matikanefukukitaru.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Wow, we really gave 110 percent out
there, huh,
Trainer!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
With my time at summer camp and the
regional
races, I've had lots of
opportunities to take in the
wonders of
nature!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
What I really want to say is, gods exist in
all kinds
of different places.
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Hm, I don't know how best to put it, but
gods
exist in every mountain, every
ocean, and every
town...
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
By connecting with them, I feel more
and more
energized.
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Oh, but that doesn't just apply to gods. I
think it
helps me to connect with other
people too.
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
People exist in all corners of this world,
most of
them strangers. By trusting in
them and having
them do the same in
return, we can all lift our
spirits
together.
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
That's what faith is all about—the power
of
believing.
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that sounded pretty deep! I can't
believe I
just said that!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
I don't know if I'm making any sense, but
never
mind that. Let's head back home!
The Arima
Kinen is waiting for us!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару
